title: The Slutty Pumpkin Returns
cn: 第 8 集 · 荡妇南瓜回归
novel: Ted finally met the [[legendary|legendary]] Slutty Pumpkin after years of searching. He had been looking for her since a Halloween party years ago. She was [[dressed|dress]] in a costume made of a pumpkin. Ted was [[thrilled|thrill]] to see her again and hoped they could start a [[relationship|relationship]]. However, things did not go as [[smoothly|smooth]] as he had [[imagined|imagine]]. The Slutty Pumpkin was not exactly what Ted had [[expected|expect]]. She was a bit [[quirky|quirky]] and had some unusual habits. Meanwhile, Barney [[discovered|discover]] that he was part [[Canadian|Canadian]]. This was a huge [[shock|shock]] for him because he always made fun of Canada. He tried to [[hide|hide]] this fact from his friends, but they eventually found out. Robin, who was Canadian herself, found the situation very [[amusing|amusing]]. She [[teased|tease]] Barney about his [[heritage|heritage]] for days. Barney [[struggled|struggle]] to [[accept|accept]] his new [[identity|identity]]. Lily was [[experiencing|experience]] pregnancy brain during this time. She kept [[forgetting|forget]] things and making silly mistakes. She left her keys in the [[refrigerator|refrigerator]] and forgot where she parked her car. Marshall found her behavior both funny and [[concerning|concern]]. Ted's date with the Slutty Pumpkin did not end well. They just did not have the [[connection|connection]] he had hoped for. Ted realized that sometimes the past is better left as a memory.

imagine.en: to form a picture in your mind

struggle.en: to try hard to do something

refrigerator.en: a machine that keeps food cold
